originality.rationale: The primary published stiff-ODE stabilization paper supplies a concrete starting mechanism, but its inspected §2–§4 do not determine the all-real-band, one-free-rescue-step minimax solution. The fully inspected published safe-Richardson result instead requires all factors contractive, a condition directly contradicted by the fixed first step in this theorem. The main two-regime sharp boundary and high-frequency normalized-bandwidth law are not implied by the identified published statement. Remaining historical fixed-root Chebyshev specializations are explicitly a residual risk.
residual_risks: A historical fixed-root or constrained Chebyshev approximation monograph may state an equivalent theorem under a different formulation.

value.rationale: Motivated by the published stiff-ODE long-step-plus-stabilizer mechanism, it provides the complete unique optimal one-step rescue for an uncertainty continuum, identifies an unexpected lower-edge-invariant branch and an exact high-band stability ceiling, and quantitatively characterizes the effective rescue bandwidth of arbitrarily high-frequency clusters. It does not rely on arbitrary finite test instances or a purely cosmetic parameter re-labeling.
